# OpenText/Micro Focus VuGen 26.1 Web (HTTP/HTML) protocol function baseline.
# Authoritative source: Function Reference > "Alphabetical Listing of Web Functions".
# Format: name,family,support_mode
#
# support_mode meanings (see function_registry.go):
#   executable        — translated to an executable DSL action / config mapping
#   native_noop       — preserved as a runtime-compatibility attribute; a guaranteed
#                        no-op in APEX Load (no client cache / no auto-resource fetch), kept out of the executed tally
#                        only via the review tally helpers
#   review_only       — preserved in the import-review artifact; has no APEX runtime
#                        equivalent and is NOT executed (never fabricate a mapping)
#
# Functions also handled by the rich switch in converter.go (web_url, web_submit_data,
# web_reg_save_param*, web_add_header, web_set_timeout, ...) are listed here too so the
# coverage doc and completeness test see the full published library; the rich handler
# owns their behavior and this row supplies classification metadata.
# web_concurrent_start/end are executable only for validated, same-scope explicit
# HTTP groups with at most 256 safe independent requests (each optionally wrapped in its
# own LR_AUTO transaction); all other spans require review.
web_add_auto_filter,web,native_noop
web_add_auto_header,web,executable
web_add_cookie,web,executable

web_add_filter,web,native_noop
